title.narrative: UNICEF responded to multiple emergencies with essential water and sanitation support throughout the year. This included helping communities affected by conflicts, floods, disease outbreaks like hepatitis E, and refugees from Sudan in Eastern Chad. The Country Office focused on building lasting solutions that connect emergency response with long-term development and peace.
